results.query: How do I paint, erase, fill and undo in a first Workbench session?
results.bounded_context_answer: Open the Workbench, pause, choose Paint and use Brush(B), Eraser(E/right-drag), Fill(G) and Ctrl+Z Undo. Precise shapes, Fill and history need paused state; focused text fields retain keys. Wait for native completion and stop/settle active Art before shared Undo. results.query: An Art batch returned queued=true. May I say the cells have been applied and displayed?
results.bounded_context_answer: No. queued is admission; executing means a worker has claimed a chunk. Wait for actual native receipts to report changed/unchanged/excluded/refused cells and any partial prefix. Neither queued nor a native applied count alone proves that a presented frame displayed the result.

results.query: Does hiding the Art window mean its request was stopped?
results.bounded_context_answer: No. Closing the Art window hides it and keeps the Workbench session. Use Stop to cancel HTTP/capture and future turns and request native retirement; an executing slice may finish and report partial changed cells. Wait for receipts and other authoring work to settle before history actions.
context_notes: Rank 2 explicitly distinguishes Hide from Stop and preserves native partial-prefix semantics. Current session and authoring excerpts corroborate it without linked-archive restore claims.

results.query: After accepted ART-SESSION-LOG-001, are yesterday’s Art conversation messages automatically restored on the next game launch?
results.bounded_context_answer: No. Every new Workbench session starts with an empty Art conversation. Hiding/reopening within the same session keeps it, but new Send does not attach old archives. Nonsecret preferences may persist; older logs remain on disk for deliberate diagnosis.
context_notes: All session claims in the returned contexts are consistently current-scoped. Preference persistence and retained traffic files do not imply conversation restoration.

results.query: Which Art diagnostics can I attach to a public bug report without leaking prompts or credentials?
results.bounded_context_answer: Attach a minimal synthetic reproduction with source/runtime identity, platform, steps, expected/actual result and a manually inspected/redacted error or receipt extract. Do not attach entire Art archives by default. Automatic credential redaction does not make prompts, model replies, images or arbitrary private text safe to publish.
context_notes: All privacy-bearing excerpts require manually inspected/redacted extracts. Automatic redaction and JSONL export never become blanket publication permission. Rank 2 supplies synthetic reproduction and identity guidance.
